env.//: EAS builds the COMMITTED git tree, and mobile/.env is gitignored, so build-time env belongs here. This is now the deployed backend (Phase 3.5), which ends the tunnel era: EXPO_PUBLIC_* is baked in at build time, so every localtunnel restart used to cost a full ~10-minute rebuild. This URL is stable across redeploys - shipping a new backend does NOT require a new APK.
